title: ペーパーマリオRPG
sources: The script (games/gc/G8MJ01.lua) is from reader's snapshots (#60, #64, #90); this entry measures it in the harness alone, from the game's file, no memory written, the script unchanged
Characters by the font's own map of glyphs to Shift-JIS, read from memory by the script: no table

Played from the title through the memory card's messages, the letter and the ship into the first town: what the script said agreed with the rows read off 31 of 31 pictures, over 4 scenes. No screen without text was among them
3 of the 31 screens repeat a talk (the same person spoken to twice). Furigana were not compared: the rows read off the screens leave them out
notes: Read by the script games/gc/G8MJ01.lua: the windows' lists of glyphs, a page at a time, with furigana and a choice's answers and cursor. Not looked at: menus, battles, a window kind not met. The build is the disc's id and its version (docs/format.md).
